The main takeaway from our work is that
the biliary excretory pathway is a sensitive and responsive system that can be influenced by a variety of chemical structures.
the bile flow induced by radiographic agents is a canalicular process that is not necessarily associated with the presence of high concentrations of bicarbonate.
the composition of canalicular bile induced by a variety of agents can be used to identify the mechanism of action of the agents.
